tasks.description: Browser verification - physics moves the visual in real Chrome (Task 6.2 browser-verification criterion)
tasks.notes: Kanban t_14c82dd1. RED: tests/e2e/physics-sync.spec.ts committed (49c21d5) and run in real headed Chrome against the live vite dev server; two RED runs failed with in-page runtime errors against the LIVE app (window.game live, boot->menu OK, three dev-server module URL 200): (1) bare 'three' import not resolvable in page.evaluate, (2) cannon-es Body has no userData. Spec fixes: import three via /node_modules/.vite/deps/three.js (optimizeDeps.include), keep mesh in window.__w2b2Meshes keyed by body.id. GREEN: 1/1 e2e passed in real Chrome. The spec drives the RUNNING frame loop through the window.game debug handle: createGround + createSphere(mass=1, y=5) in the app's real cannon-es world, a red THREE sphere mesh registered with the app's BodySync. Assertions: (a) TELEPORT PROOF - body teleported to y=25 without touching the mesh; after ~1s of real frames the mesh y matched the body within 1e-3, proving the loop's per-frame sync() moved the visual; (b) 30 frame-over-frame samples over ~483 ms: body fell from y~19.9 to y~13.9 under gravity, mesh moved identically, max mesh/body drift = 0; (c) rAF frame counter advanced through 30 distinct values. Full unit suite 404/404 (19 files) green; tsc clean; eslint 0 errors; build ok. Changes: tests/e2e/physics-sync.spec.ts (new), tsconfig.node.json (include playwright.config.ts + tests/e2e for typed lint).
